name: @hivemagnus/magnus
description: Install, upgrade and roll back a Magnus server and console with one command: `npx @hivemagnus/magnus init`, then `magnus upgrade`. Pins exact, tested component versions, backs up PostgreSQL before every migration and reverts automatically when the new version fails its health check.
author: ChefTaco

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AUTO_MIGRATE
newOptionalEnv.description: Apply pending migrations at startup, after a pg_dump, under an advisory lock (default false; true in `magnus init` projects and the images).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AUTO_MIGRATE_BACKUP
newOptionalEnv.description: Dump the database before an automatic migration (default true).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AUTO_MIGRATE_ALLOW_SLOW
newOptionalEnv.description: Let auto-migrate apply migrations marked slow or one-way (default false).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_RUNTIME_FILE
newOptionalEnv.description: File the server writes after it starts listening, read by upgrade tooling.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_UPDATE_CHECK
newOptionalEnv.description: Daily npm registry check for new releases (default true; set false to opt out).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_UPDATE_REGISTRY
newOptionalEnv.description: npm registry for the update check and agent release lookups.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_UPGRADE_CONCURRENCY
newOptionalEnv.description: Agents upgraded in parallel after the canary (default 5).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_LEGACY_GIT_SELF_UPDATE
newOptionalEnv.description: Keep the git-checkout self-update endpoints (default false).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_SELF_UPGRADE
newOptionalEnv.description: Accept server-driven upgrades to an exact version and integrity (default true).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_UPGRADE_CONFIRM_SECONDS
newOptionalEnv.description: Seconds a new version has to report an accepted heartbeat before the launcher reverts it (default 180).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_UPGRADE_REQUIRE_PROVENANCE
newOptionalEnv.description: Refuse a staged upgrade unless `npm audit signatures` passes (default true).

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_AGENT_UPGRADE_SOURCE_DIR
newOptionalEnv.description: Install self-upgrades from local tarballs instead of the registry.

magnusRelease.summary: Easy upgrades: `npx @hivemagnus/magnus init`, `magnus upgrade` with backup and automatic revert, startup auto-migrate, update notices, and server-driven agent upgrades with self-revert.
